identity.name: Heritage Classic Sector
identity.one_liner: The 38.5mm Heritage Classic Sector — the 1930s Longines sector-dial reissue with the L893 caliber. The most-cited modern Longines dress watch.

narrative.story: The Heritage Classic Sector is the 2019 reissue of a 1930s Longines with a sector-dial layout. The 38.5mm stainless steel case, the silvered dial with the sector pattern, and the L893 caliber (ETA-based with a 72-hour reserve) are the 2019 specification. The Heritage Classic Sector is the most-cited modern Longines dress watch and the watch a collector cites when they want a 1930s sector-dial design with a modern manufacture caliber.
narrative.collector_notes: The sector dial divides the dial into sectors (the minute track, the hour numerals, the sub-seconds) — a 1930s design language that is most associated with Patek (the 1938 Calatrava sector dial) and Longines.
